# Seb Trân — Director of Photography (Paris)

> Seb Trân (also Sébastien Trân, Seb Tran) is a Paris-based director of photography / cinematographer (chef opérateur) working mainly in beauty, fashion and fragrance advertising, plus music videos and short films. He also directs.

## Key facts
- Role: Director of photography (cinematographer); also director / DP
- Based in: Paris, France — available worldwide
- Specialities: beauty, fashion, fragrance and luxury commercials; music videos; short films
- Brands shot for (see film index): AMI Paris, Yves Saint Laurent, Lancôme, Clarins, L'Oréal Paris, Biotherm, Balmain, Cartier, Chaumet
- Production company: Moodpics

- [Portfolio — cinematography](https://sebastien-tran.com/#cinematography): films shot as director of photography, with brand, director and production company
- [Portfolio — direction](https://sebastien-tran.com/#direction): films directed by Seb Trân
